The defendant Board had the statutory power to repair sea walls but was under no duty to do so. A high tide
broke the sea wall and flooded the plaintiff's land. The Board sent an inexperienced man with poor equipment
and the repair work took almost six months to complete. It was proved that with reasonable skill it could have
been completed in about two weeks. The defendant is:
1. Liable in negligence as they had legal duty to take care towards the and committed its breach.
2. * Liable in negligence they should have sent experienced with equipment to do the work.
3. ¥ Not liable in negligence they owed legal duty take towards the plaintiff.
4, * Not liable in negligence they have done whatever they could have done under the circumstances.
